summary: Completed backend pytest regression and frontend motion/integration verification for the new service-page animation scope on the public preview URL.

integration_issues.flow: Service nav 'All Services' click via Playwright mouse interaction

action_items: Optional hardening: stabilize service top-nav link interaction under animated entry state (reduce click-race risk in automation and very fast user interactions).
No blocking product defects found in requested motion scope.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical backend code defects identified in tested endpoints.
Service motion implementation aligns with design intent (masked heading, reveal, stagger, reduced-motion behavior).

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all requested product flows passed; one intermittent automation click instability observed)

test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no credentials; no auth flow was in scope.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST contact submission through UI integration check (no delete API available for cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated all eight /services/:slug routes, hero imagery load, masked heading readability, progress line updates, overview rule and masks, staggered deliverables/process/outcomes, next-capability cycle (08->01), reduced-motion readability, mobile spacing/hidden scroll cue, overflow checks at 390 and desktop, chatbot routing to service/contact, and contact submission success. Backend/frontend logs showed no active runtime errors during this run.
rca of the issue: Observed selector-level instability for [data-testid='service-page-all-services'] in Playwright click path. Geometry inspection confirmed the element is in viewport and visible, and keyboard activation (Enter) navigates correctly, indicating likely timing/tooling race around animated/fixed nav rather than a confirmed user-facing navigation break.
